meta.name: fiscaliste
meta.description:
Fiscaliste IA pour la fiscalité personnelle des particuliers français : optimisation
et déclaration de l'impôt sur le revenu, IFI, revenus du capital, revenus fonciers,
equity salarial, crypto-actifs et PER.

Couvre le calcul de l'IR (barème, quotient familial, décote, PAS, CEHR, revenus
exceptionnels), la déclaration 2042 et annexes, les revenus du capital (PFU vs barème,
PEA, assurance-vie, dividendes, plus-values), les revenus fonciers (micro/réel,
déficit, LMNP, SCI IR), l'equity startup (RSU, BSPCE, stock-options, PEE/PERCO),
la fiscalité crypto (PAMC, 2086), l'IFI et les déductions (PER, pension alimentaire).

Triggers: impôt sur le revenu, IR, 2042, quotient familial, décote, PAS, PFU,
flat tax, PEA, assurance-vie, LMNP, revenus fonciers, déficit foncier, SCI IR, RSU,
BSPCE, stock-options, PEE/PERCO, crypto, 2086, IFI, PER, plafond PER, niche fiscale,
optimisation fiscale, simulation IR, TMI.

Hors scope : succession/donation (notaire), IS/SASU/arbitrage dividende-salaire/SCI IS
(comptable).

copy.tagline: 计算并优化法国个人所得税与财富税
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是法国税务居民，需要计算个税或优化税务方案。
copy.tagline_en: Calculate and optimize French personal income and wealth taxes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a French tax resident needing to compute or optimize your taxes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会作为法国个税顾问，针对所得税、资本收入、房产、股权、加密资产、IFI、PER等给出优化与申报建议，计算时会逐步展示每一步公式，不凭空给数字，并提示核对官方来源。
howto.when: 当用户提到法国个人所得税、申报表2042、PFU、PEA、房产收入、RSU、加密货币、IFI、PER等税务话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我模拟2025年收入要交多少所得税
say.note: Claude会按步骤计算并列出税率表
会说明按工资申报及后续资本利得处理

say.text: 卖出加密货币怎么计算PFU？

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a French personal tax advisor, covering income tax, capital income, property, equity, crypto, IFI, and PER. It shows each calculation step, never invents tax rates, and points to official sources.
howto.when_en: Enables when users ask about French income tax, form 2042, PFU, PEA, rental income, RSU, crypto, IFI, PER, or similar tax topics.

say_en.note: Claude walks through the calculation and tax bands.
Explains salary treatment and later capital gains.

say_en.text: How is PFU calculated on crypto sales?
say_en.note: Explains the 31.4% flat tax and form 2086.
